# Copilot Instructions — INOWAS Morpheus

## Project Context

This workspace is managed by the Nexus platform.
Follow the project conventions and architectural decisions documented in the codebase.

## Code Style

- Use TypeScript with strict mode enabled
- Prefer named exports over default exports
- Use early returns to reduce nesting
- Keep functions focused and under 50 lines
- Use descriptive variable and function names

## Architecture

- Follow existing patterns in the codebase
- Respect the separation of concerns in the project structure
- When suggesting changes, consider the impact on the existing architecture

## Testing

- Include test suggestions when generating new functions
- Follow the existing test patterns in the project

## Security

- Never suggest hardcoded secrets or credentials
- Use environment variables for configuration
- Follow secure coding practices
